question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve are friends and avid readers who occasionally trade books. At the start of the semester, they each buy one new book: Alice gets Walden, Bob gets Siddhartha, Claire gets The Hobbit, Dave gets Candide, and Eve gets Emma.
As the semester proceeds, they start trading around the new books. First, Bob and Alice swap books. Then, Alice and Bob swap books. Then, Dave and Bob swap books. Then, Dave and Bob swap books. Finally, Dave and Eve swap books. At the end of the semester, Bob has
Options:
(A) Walden
(B) Siddhartha
(C) The Hobbit
(D) Candide
(E) Emma
solution:
Owners in each row: Alice | Bob | Claire | Dave | Eve
Initial: Walden | Siddhartha | The Hobbit | Candide | Emma
1. Bob ↔ Alice: Siddhartha | Walden | The Hobbit | Candide | Emma
2. Alice ↔ Bob: Walden | Siddhartha | The Hobbit | Candide | Emma
3. Dave ↔ Bob: Walden | Candide | The Hobbit | Siddhartha | Emma
4. Dave ↔ Bob: Walden | Siddhartha | The Hobbit | Candide | Emma
5. Dave ↔ Eve: Walden | Siddhartha | The Hobbit | Emma | Candide
Bob has Siddhartha, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
